question: how do I reset my password
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Reset Password, then follow the emailed link.
child_answer: Tap the little gear settings icon, click on your profile name, and tap 'Reset Password'. Ask an adult to check their email for the magic link!

question: how do I update my payment method
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods to add or update a card.
child_answer: Ask a parent to go to Settings, tap Billing, and update their credit card details.

question: how do I cancel my subscription
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Manage Plan and select Cancel Subscription.
child_answer: Go to Settings, tap Billing, click on Manage Plan, and click Cancel to stop the subscription.

question: how do I change my email address
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Email, enter the new address, and confirm via the verification email.
child_answer: Go to Settings, tap Account, enter the new email address, and tap the link sent to your inbox to verify it!

question: how do I delete my account
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. This is permanent and cannot be undone.
child_answer: Go to Settings, tap Account, and click Delete. Warning: this deletes your game/account forever!

question: the app keeps crashing on startup
answer: Try clearing the app cache, or reinstalling the latest version from the store.
child_answer: Try closing and reopening the app, clearing its memory, or asking a parent to reinstall it from the app store!

question: I cannot log in to my account
answer: Double check your credentials, then try Settings > Security > Reset Password if the issue persists.
child_answer: Make sure you typed your username and password correctly. If not, tap Reset Password to get back in!

question: where is my order
answer: Track your order under Orders > Order History > Track Package.
child_answer: Go to Orders, tap Order History, and click Track Package to see exactly where your toy is on the map!

question: how long does shipping take
answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days; express shipping takes 1-2 business days.
child_answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 days (almost a whole week!). Super fast express takes only 1-2 days!

question: how do I return an item
answer: Go to Orders > Order History > Return Item and follow the prompts to print a return label.
child_answer: Go to Orders, tap Return Item, print the sticky label, put the toy back in the box, tape it, and give it to the postman!
